patthana22.7:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.7:3.1: na kusalaṃ no ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.7:5.1: na kusalaṃ no oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.7:7.1: na kusalaṃ no yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.7:9.1: na kusalaṃ no nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo nīvaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.7:11.1: na kusalaṃ no parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na
